author: bingwang-ms

**Description**
```show platform firmware status``` throws exception due to lack of ```sonic_platform``` on Celestica-DX010.
```
admin@str-dx010-acs-4:/usr/local/lib/python3.7$ show platform firmware status
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/fwutil/__init__.py", line 2, in <module>
    from sonic_platform.platform import Platform
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'sonic_platform'

During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/fwutil", line 6, in <module>
    from fwutil.main import cli
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/fwutil/__init__.py", line 5, in <module>
    raise ImportError("Required module not found: {}".format(str(e)))
ImportError: Required module not found: No module named 'sonic_platform'
```
<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run ```show platform firmware status```
2.
3.

**Describe the results you received:**
An exception is thrown.

**Describe the results you expected:**
No exception should be thrown.

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body: @jleveque , is this dx010 platform specific problem?

comments.author: jleveque
comments.body:
> @jleveque , is this dx010 platform specific problem?

No, a few vendors are not yet installing a Python 3 version of their sonic-platform package. Mellanox is currently working on theirs.

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body: you mean yes? do we need to ask Celestica to fix this issue on their platform?

comments.author: jleveque
comments.body: I misinterpreted your question. This issue is specific to a few platforms, not only Celestica. Yes, we need to ask Celestica to create and install a Python 3 version of their sonic-platform wheel package.

linkedPullRequests.title: [device/celestica]: Fix failed test cases of DX010 platform APIs
linkedPullRequests.author: mudsut4ke
linkedPullRequests.body:
**- Why I did it**
- To fix failed test cases of DX010 platform APIs that found on [platform_tests](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/tree/master/tests/platform_tests/api) script

**- How I did it**
1. Add device/celestica/x86_64-cel_seastone-r0/platform.json 
2. Update functions to support python3.7
3. Add more functions follow latest sonic_platform_base
4. Fix the bug

 **- How to verify it**
- Run  [platform_tests](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/tree/master/tests/platform_tests/api) script
